definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens little by little over time, with a sense of persistence or inevitability. Often implies a slow but inexorable progress.
Describes liquid slowly spreading or seeping, or a sensation gradually spreading through the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物価|ぶっか}→物価：03607_bukka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じわじわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
じわじわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{効|き}いて→効く：01932_kiku⟧⟦くる→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: It's a medicine that works gradually.

examples.japanese: じわじわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じわじわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{額|ひたい}→額：03579_hitai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{滲|にじ}んで→滲む：04570_nijimu⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: Sweat slowly started to bead on my forehead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧じわじわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{染|し}み{込|こ}んで→染み込む：07893_shimikomu⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Water slowly seeped into the concrete.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧⟦もの→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べたら→食べる：00396_taberu⟧、じわじわ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{熱|あつ}くなって→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: After eating something spicy, my mouth gradually started to burn.

notes:
USAGE:
じわじわ(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧) + verb

Sense 1 (gradual change):
Emphasizes slow, persistent change that may not be immediately noticeable but accumulates over time:
- じわじわ(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧ (to increase gradually)
- じわじわ(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)⟦{広|ひろ}がる→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧ (to spread slowly)
- じわじわ(⟦と→と：00512_to⟧)⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (to close in gradually)

Sense 2 (seeping/spreading):
Describes liquids or sensations spreading slowly:
- じわじわ⟦{滲|にじ}む→滲む：04570_nijimu⟧ (to seep out slowly)
- じわじわ⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to gradually get hot)
Often carries a sense of something inevitable or relentless — the change may be slow, but it is persistent and will eventually have a significant effect.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}に→徐々に：04131_jojoni⟧ - gradually (more formal, and more neutral in tone)
- ⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧ - gradually, more and more
- ⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧ - slowly (focus on pace, not on accumulation)
